# SYNTHETIC JOB DESCRIPTION 03 — Fintech Backend Engineer (Intern to FTE)
# Label: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE (NOT A REAL JOB POSTING)

Position: Backend Software Development Engineer 1
Company: PayVault Financial Technologies
Location: Mumbai / Pune / Remote (India)
Package: ₹9 LPA – ₹14 LPA

Overview:
PayVault processes secure digital payments and merchant settlements across India. We are looking for talented entry-level backend engineers who care about transactional integrity, latency, and clean API design.

Core Responsibilities:
• Implement secure, reliable REST microservices in Node.js (TypeScript) or Python (FastAPI/Django).
• Write optimized SQL queries and manage migrations in PostgreSQL.
• Design caching strategies using Redis to reduce database read pressure.
• Containerize microservices using Docker and assist in deployment pipeline management on AWS.
• Monitor application error rates and telemetry logs.

Mandatory Qualifications:
• B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or related technical disciplines.
• Strong foundation in backend development using Node.js or Python.
• Hands-on proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and query optimization.
• Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP status codes, and authentication mechanisms (JWT, OAuth2).
• Experience with Git, Linux terminal, and Docker basics.

Bonus Points:
• Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or BullMQ).
• Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS).
• Participation in hackathons or open-source software contributions.
